stories.title: LIV Golf Bankruptcy Expected by September 7
stories.angle: LIV Golf is preparing to file for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection as soon as September 7 — the same weekend the Solheim Cup opens and four days from today. Player settlements are being offered at pennies on the dollar. BC Partners talks remain unresolved. More than 50 contracted players face uncertainty.

stories.title: Biltmore Championship — The Fall Swing's Most Intriguing New Event
stories.angle: Two weeks from today (Sept 17-20), the inaugural Biltmore Championship tees off at The Cliffs at Walnut Cove in Asheville, North Carolina — marking the PGA Tour's return to the Blue Ridge Mountains for the first time since Ben Hogan played there in the early 1940s. The debut event carries extra significance as a symbol of Asheville's recovery from Hurricane Helene.
